name: pop-reminder-website
description: 『ふわっと。』公式プロモーションサイト

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && npx --yes wrangler@4.118.0 pages dev
scripts.check: node --check main.js && node --check functions/api/waitlist.js && node scripts/check-waitlist.mjs && node scripts/check-site.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx --yes wrangler@4.118.0 d1 migrations apply pop-reminder-waitlist --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx --yes wrangler@4.118.0 d1 migrations apply pop-reminder-waitlist --remote
scripts.waitlist:count: npx --yes wrangler@4.118.0 d1 execute pop-reminder-waitlist --remote --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS signups FROM waitlist_signups;"
scripts.waitlist:campaigns: npx --yes wrangler@4.118.0 d1 execute pop-reminder-waitlist --remote --command "SELECT COALESCE(utm_source, '(direct)') AS source, COALESCE(utm_medium, '(none)') AS medium, COALESCE(utm_campaign, '(none)') AS campaign, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM waitlist_signups GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY signups DESC;"
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run verify && npx --yes wrangler@4.118.0 pages deploy --branch main --commit-dirty=true
